rko.title: CPR guide
rko.intro: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation of an adult who is unresponsive and not breathing normally.
rko.draftNotice: Draft version. The text is based on ZPE educational material and awaits medical review.

reaction.title: Check whether the person responds
reaction.body: Gently shake them by the shoulders and ask loudly if they are all right.

help.title: Shout for help
help.body: Shout for someone to bring an AED and call 112. If you are alone, do it with your phone.

airway.title: Open the airway and check breathing
airway.body: Tilt the head back and lift the chin. Look, listen and feel for breathing for no more than 10 seconds.

call.title: Call 112
call.body: If the person is not breathing normally, call 112 or 999. Switch on speakerphone.

compress.title: Press on the chest
compress.body: Place your hands on the lower half of the breastbone with your arms straight. Press 5–6 cm deep, 100–120 times a minute.

breaths.title: Rescue breaths
breaths.body: If you are able and willing, give 2 calm breaths of about one second each after 30 compressions. If not, press without stopping.

aed.title: When the AED arrives
aed.body: Switch it on, attach the pads as shown in the pictures and follow the voice prompts. Nobody touches the person while the rhythm is analysed.

continue.title: Do not stop
continue.body: Carry on until the emergency services arrive, the person starts breathing normally or you are exhausted. If others can help, swap every 2 minutes.

metronome.title: Compression rhythm
metronome.description: The sound and the counter help you keep a pace of 110 compressions per minute.
metronome.silentHint: You can mute the sound on your phone. The counter keeps working.

rko.source: Source: Zintegrowana Platforma Edukacyjna (zpe.gov.pl), material “Resuscytacja krążeniowo-oddechowa”. Text reworded.
rko.callHint: The dispatcher will guide you through CPR over the phone. Switch on speakerphone.

about.title: About the app
about.lead: A prototype prepared for the “AED Mission – Data to the Rescue” competition of the Ministry of Digital Affairs.

data.title: Data
data.body: AED locations come from the combined list “AED defibrillators in Poland – combined dataset” on the dane.gov.pl portal, which merges AED datasets published by different providers (licence: {license}). The data may be incomplete or out of date. Number of points: {count}.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: The app has no accounts and does not track users. Your location is processed only on your device and is not sent to a server. Address search sends only the text you type. Map tiles are loaded from OpenStreetMap servers, which can see your device's IP address.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The app is designed to WCAG 2.2 level AA, and to AAA where possible. An accessibility statement will be published after an audit.

openData.title: Open data
openData.body: The dataset can be downloaded as CSV and GeoJSON together with a metadata description. Contact details of device owners have been removed.

errors.notFoundBody: Check the address or go back to the map.
errors.errorBody: Try again. In an emergency, call 112.
